_comment: Secondary legislation deposited 2026-10-08 for the Israel rows IL-25 to IL-36. Each file is the raw MediaWiki source of the Hebrew Wikisource page (The Open Book of Laws) as maintained at the retrieved_at time, which is an UNOFFICIAL consolidation: the official text is the original publication in Reshumot (Kovetz HaTakanot) together with every amending instrument. Israel has no copyright in statutes or regulations (Copyright Act 5768-2007 s 6). The template apparatus (ח:תיבה etc.) carries the Reshumot citations and olaw.org.il / Knesset PDF links. Hebrew bytes are exactly as retrieved (UTF-8).
